request_routes.label: Intravenous rituximab (Rituxan) or biosimilar therapy
request_routes.routing_notes: Initial and continuation coverage for hematologic, oncologic, rheumatologic, and other immune-mediated indications described in Sections I and III with corresponding continuation criteria in Sections II and IV.
request_routes.evidence: Aetna considers rituximab (Rituxan), rituximab-abbs (Truxima), rituximab-arrx (Riabni), or rituximab-pvvr (Ruxience) medically necessary for the oncologic, hematologic, immune checkpoint toxicity, rheumatoid arthritis and other autoimmune indications listed in Sections I.A, I.B, I.C, and III, with continuation coverage guided by Sections II and IV.

request_routes.label: Rituxan Hycela subcutaneous rituximab/hyaluronidase
request_routes.routing_notes: Rituxan Hycela is covered only for the CD20-positive oncologic disorders listed once the member has tolerated a prior intravenous rituximab dose, with continuation limited to situations without unacceptable toxicity.
request_routes.evidence: Aetna considers rituximab and hyaluronidase (Rituxan Hycela) medically necessary for treatment of the specified CD20-positive oncologic disorders in members who have received at least one full IV rituximab dose without severe adverse reactions, with continuation when no unacceptable toxicity is observed.
